cohort: The study included 81 newborns diagnosed with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) and 50 healthy control newborns, all over 37 gestational weeks.
finding: Thyroid hormone levels (TSH and fT4) varied significantly over time in HIE infants at various Sarnat stages, with moderate HIE newborns showing higher TSH and fT4 levels compared to healthy, mild, and severe HIE neonates on postnatal day 5.
mod_finding: No statistically significant differences were found between HIE and healthy babies regarding mode of delivery.
birth_weight: Not specified, but comparable between HIE and control groups.
